model_annotation: The chart illustrates “effect” values across language families for six model–layer combinations, shown as grouped bars with error bars. The horizontal axis contains the categorical families in left-to-right order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic; the axis label reads “family.” The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 10, 20, and 30 (values extend slightly below 0 and up to the mid-30s). For each family, six adjacent bars appear in the legend order and colors: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red), each with a vertical error bar. Approximate bar heights by family are: IE-Baltic shows small positive effects (about 1–6) across all six bars; IE-Germanic shows mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ near ~10, mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ near 0 to slightly negative, and mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ near ~15; IE-Indic shows mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ near 0, mBERT-R₂ around ~20, XLM-R₂ around ~18, mBERT-B₂ around ~24, and XLM-B₂ around ~21; IE-Romance shows mBERT-L₂ around ~6, XLM-L₂ around ~4, mBERT-R₂ around ~5, XLM-R₂ around ~1, mBERT-B₂ around ~12–13, and XLM-B₂ around ~6; IE-Slavic shows mBERT-L₂ around ~10–11, XLM-L₂ around ~9, mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ near ~1, mBERT-B₂ around ~17, and XLM-B₂ around ~15–16; IE-other shows mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ around ~6, mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ near 0, and mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ around ~8; Isolate shows values clustered near 0–2 for all bars; Semitic shows mBERT-L₂ around ~11, XLM-L₂ around ~16, mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ slightly negative (around −2 to −1), mBERT-B₂ around ~15, and XLM-B₂ around ~19–20; Uralic shows small positive values near ~0–2 across all bars. The bars are not visually sorted by magnitude (they follow the family order on the x-axis), and no bars are specially emphasized beyond the consistent color coding and the presence of error bars.
